g.text: LEGEND (IEC 60617 / IEEE 315; device numbers ANSI/IEEE C37.2)
MAXIMUM DEMAND SUMMARY (MD = C + 0.3 I + 0.1 S)
1. Normal operation: both incomers closed, bus ties NORMALLY OPEN (N.O.) at 13.8 kV, 4.16 kV and
2. Each transformer sized for the total unit maximum demand (one out of service, tie closed): ONAN
>= MD, ONAF >= 1.25 x MD (25 % future). See CFU-000-EL-CAL-001.
3. Tie breakers: 2-out-of-3 electrical/key interlock per board (no paralleling of transformers);
auto-transfer (open transition) on loss of incomer, with residual-voltage supervision (27R).
4. 4.16 kV system low-resistance grounded (400 A); 480 V high-resistance grounded (5 A, alarm).
5. Pump A/B (2 x 100 %) are always fed from opposite bus sections; the normally running unit of
each pair is selected to balance the buses (load list CFU-000-EL-LDL-001).
6. No emergency diesel generator: essential loads (DCS/SIS/F&G/telecom) on 2 x 100 % UPS, 30 min
autonomy; unit fails safe on total power loss. See SLD-004 note 1.
7. Detailed MV / LV / UPS SLDs: CFU-000-EL-SLD-002 / -003 (2 sheets) / -004.
8. Short-circuit ratings: symmetrical interrupting kA; utility 31.5 kA at 13.8 kV (basis).
